input: RGB photo stretched to 224x224, float32 raw 0-255 (preprocessing is inside the model)
output: raw sigmoid; apply calibration: p = sigmoid(A * logit(raw) + B), equal prior odds
labels: healthy = SCTL teat-end score 1-2 + healthy close-ups; problem = score 3-4 + teat lesions
limitations: healthy teats that don't look like the SCTL photos are often flagged (8/12 in test)
misses about half of rough teat-end rings (score 3)
validated only on web/Roboflow/SCTL images, not field photos
must sit behind the photo gate: non-teat photos are almost always called 'problem'
